messages:
maya: thinking about adding a small in-console guided tour for 'role presets' — quick tooltip that shows what each preset grants + an example request mapping. helps customers pick the right one quickly.
alex: +1 for a tiny tour. worried about cluttering the UI though. can it be collapsed/opt-in?
jon: if we do it, include a preview of the effective permissions for a tenant admin. we always get support tickets where customers assume presets are global when they're tenant-scoped.
sophia: agree with jon. also telemetry: tag clicks so we can see which presets people actually use. send that to analytics with the preset id and tenant id (hashed).
maya: good call on telemetry. we should be careful to not leak sensitive tenant info — hashed tenant id only, no role names linked to PII. legal reviewed similar telemetry for quota UI last quarter.
tom: API side question — do we want presets to be first-class resources? i.e. POST /api/v1/role-presets and GET /api/v1/role-presets? current internal model stores presets as UI config blobs.
alex: i'd prefer first-class. makes sharing across teams (and Dedicated deployments) easier and simplifies console->api contract. also enables audit logs for preset usage.
jon: example payload we could standardize on:

POST /api/v1/role-presets
{
  "name": "Billing Viewer",
  "description": "Read-only billing access for finance",
  "scope_ids": ["billing.read","invoices.view"],
  "applies_to": "tenant",      // tenant | organization | global
  "recommended_routes": ["/billing/*"],
}

alex: please add `created_by` and `auditable: true` flags. audits are a big ask from enterprise customers.
sophia: UX detail: the tooltip should have a small inline diff view (like effective permissions) so admins can see what the preset adds vs a baseline 'tenant-admin-lite'.
maya: rollout plan proposal: alpha behind a feature flag for internal + 3 customers, collect click telemetry + support logs for 2 weeks, then canary 10% orgs, then full.
tom: migration worry: we have a bunch of orgs with custom presets in the UI config blob. migration script should detect conflicts and create preset resources with suffix `-migrated-{ts}` and mark them as 'private'.
jon: also add a console warning when applying a preset that escalates permissions (highlight the new scopes in red) — reduces accidental over-permissions.
console-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag 'role-presets-tour' created in phabricator diff D1234, env: staging, owner: @maya
maya: thanks @console-bot. i'll draft the tooltip copy and the telemetry event schema and share the PR. keeping the copy short and actionable (2 bullets + link to docs). any objections to `preset` terminology? alternatives: `templates`, `bundles`.
alex: prefer `preset` — clearer to customers.
sophia: ok with `preset`. one more ask: add a telemetry counter for 'preview diff viewed' so we can track whether people actually audit before applying.
maya: noted. i'll include that. no blockers from me, moving to design sync.
